final: WITH rc AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM rc), av AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM rc), r AS (SELECT rc.region, rc.cnt, rc.cnt * 1.0 / tot.total AS ratio FROM rc JOIN tot ON tot.total IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT r.cnt, r.ratio, r.cnt - av.avg_cnt AS diff FROM r JOIN av ON av.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL WHERE r.cnt > av.avg_cnt) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM k
